cards.t: SEC Approves Volatility Shares' 3x Leveraged Bitcoin and Ether ETFs
cards.b: The SEC has cleared Cboe to list Volatility Shares' six new 3x leveraged Bitcoin and Ether funds, which are set for exchange launch.

per.BTC: Approved 3x leveraged ETP products (like BITH) add new derivative exposure for traders.
per.ETH: Approved 3x leveraged ETP products (like ETHK) add new derivative exposure for ETH traders.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST

cards.t: Zcash Activates NU7 on Testnet Ahead of Mainnet
cards.b: Zcash has activated the NU7 upgrade on its public testnet, cutting target block time from 75 seconds to 25 seconds ahead of a planned November mainnet launch.

per.ZEC: NU7 testnet activation provides a live rehearsal for exchanges and wallets ahead of the November mainnet rollout.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST

cards.t: Near Intents Recovers Fully Drained Funds Following Ultimatum
cards.b: Near Intents recovered the entirety of the approximately $3.8 million drained during a recent exploit after issuing a 48-hour ultimatum to the identified attacker.

per.NEAR: Full recovery of drained funds eliminates the security overhang from the recent exploit.

cards.label: COMPLETED CATALYST
